sample.txt:
My thoughts are all over the place and I been up all night so I could've worded all of this much better but, it's a phenomenal movie that I'm sure every fellow hardcore fan of the series will love.

Nothing brings me more joy than Gintama, so I'm so SO grateful they delivered 🥹 https://t.co/TKSMTxDh

Regarding this long story arc being reworked into a 2 hour movie, the parts that were cut didn't hurt the overall pacing of the movie, thus making it (to an extent) a watchable standalone for those with minimal knowledge on the series. I think that was one of the team's aims.

In all seriousness, this movie was fantastic from start to finish. I always talked about how I wanted to see this arc brought back to life in the future, especially in the form of a live action, but they successfully managed to rework into a 2 hour animated movie. https://t.co/liegcrz73c

Animation and art style wise, this is undoubtedly the BEST that Gintama has ever looked, with a lot of effort also being put into the camera work to depicted the beauty of the Yoshiwara Shangri-la. It was quite a step-up from The Final. https://t.co/fQXYVc5OQ6
